subject.title: fix(docs): bound channel docs find fallback with timeout

question: Should the fallback be redesigned around an independently supervised enumeration process that can be abandoned at the deadline, or should the synchronous fallback be removed or documented as only a best-effort timeout?
rationale: A safe isolation boundary must define leaked-child, stdio, process-group, and cleanup behavior; that policy choice cannot be inferred from the existing synchronous helper.

options.title: Adopt isolated enumeration
options.body: Use a nonblocking, independently supervised child or worker so the test runner can fail or skip at the deadline without waiting for the stalled enumeration to exit.

options.title: Retain best-effort synchronous timeout
options.body: Keep `spawnSync` only if maintainers accept that it improves ordinary stalls but cannot guarantee test-suite liveness and revise the claim and documentation accordingly.

options.title: Remove the fallback path
options.body: Avoid filesystem enumeration when `git ls-files` is unavailable if preserving an alternate checkout mode is not required.

recommendation.title: Adopt isolated enumeration
recommendation.body: Use a nonblocking, independently supervised child or worker so the test runner can fail or skip at the deadline without waiting for the stalled enumeration to exit.

likelyOwner.reason: Their closely related merged timeout work provides the most direct established contract for distinguishing a practical subprocess timeout from a hard liveness guarantee.
